note: A Ministry of Health release of 4 August 2025 on the launch of biometric patient identification at KUTRRH. It says 24 counties are transitioning to Hospital Management Information Systems without saying what those systems do, so their class is empty and there is no fact of class hmis or emr; biometric identification is an identity layer, entered as enabling. It also says 99% of KUTRRH walk-in patients are registered under SHA.
